correctness.rationale: Exact one-coordinate minimization identity, concavity under averaging \(p_1,p_2\), and exact 1+2 invariant-block spectrum reduce the full simplex problem to one scalar. The symmetric lower eigenvalue is strictly concave because the discriminant square root has positive second derivative \(32c^2(1+r-2c^2)>0\). Characteristic determinant establishes a single crossing with the linear antisymmetric mode; comparing with the unique smooth maximum yields the precise critical quadratic \(2c^2+(1-r)c-2r=0\). Boundaries, strict SPD domain and exact-rational spectra were checked. The executable is supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural minimal frustrated inverse-sign triangle defeats the published inverse-positive closed form and has identical coordinate curvature scales. The new exact optimum is a nonuniform allocation with a nontrivial crossover from double to simple active contraction modes. The formulas replace generic SDP solving for this meaningful two-parameter class, with exact rates and a mechanism explaining when mode balancing ceases.
